name: Suppression of the January Uprising (1863–1864) (C0062)

techniques.comment: The purge of civic communities in the wake of the uprising's suppression: "the suppression of the Polish uprising of 1863–1864, which had a corresponding impact on the Ukrainophile movement, interpreted by the tsarist administration as an Austrian intrigue, led to the self-dissolution of the hromadas and the fading of public activity"(Citation: Національне питання в Україні ХХ – початку ХХІ ст. 2012).

The use of the regular army to suppress the January Uprising: Muravyov and Berg, appointed by the emperor, "resorted to brutal repressions and terror with the aim of suppressing the uprising"; "hundreds of Poles were executed, thousands exiled to Siberia or given over to the army"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 8 2011).
